active_work_package.title: Operate gains an outputs section that names what it already produces and what reaches Learn - issue #55 (NS-034)
active_work_package.objective: Give operate.html the outputs section every other stage has, naming the thirteen artifacts its body and gate already require and which two reach Learn; amend Learn's entry criterion to say where its inputs come from; renumber the Operate sections and every catalogue citation of them in the same change; retire the spine test's Operate exemption. Add no artifact, no owner and no register.
